appeal.title: Appeal your ban
appeal.description: Tell us why you think this was a mistake. A moderator will review your case.
appeal.messagePlaceholder: Explain why your ban should be lifted (at least 10 characters)…

closed.body: New account sign-ups are paused right now. Please check back later.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: A couple of steps and you're on air.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send a link to set a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If that email is in our system, we've sent a password reset link. Follow it to set a new password.
sent.spamHint: Didn't get the email? Check your spam folder, or try again in a couple of minutes.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password — it replaces the old one as soon as you save.
resetPassword.genericError: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.
resetPassword.successToastDescription: Sign in with your new password.

missingToken.title: Invalid link
missingToken.body: This link is missing its reset token. Request a new email and follow the link in full.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: This password reset link has expired or already been used. Request a new one — it'll reach your inbox in a couple of minutes.

verifying.title: Verifying your email
verifying.body: One moment — we're checking your link.

success.title: Email verified
success.body: Thanks! Your address is confirmed — everything on ruletka.top is now unlocked.

error.title: We couldn't verify it
error.bodyAuthed: This link has expired or already been used. Request a new email — it'll reach your inbox in a couple of minutes.
error.bodyGuest: This link has expired or already been used. Sign in to request a new email.

noToken.title: Invalid link
noToken.body: This link is missing its verification token. Open the email again and follow the link in full.

verifyEmail.resendSuccessToastDescription: Check your inbox and follow the new link.
verifyEmail.resendErrorToastDescription: Please try again in a little while.
